request: What happens inside one Llama-style decoder block?

composition.story: What happens inside one Llama-style decoder block? Start with three illustrative token positions and track the middle position, B. Follow attention, then the MLP, watching each update join the running stream. The final state reveals which branch mixes positions and how both updates accumulate.

aha.observation: Attention mixes information across permitted positions; the MLP transforms each position separately, and both updates enter the running stream through residual additions.

parts.presentation: Use the approved card shell and canonical pipeline arrangement. Keep story and instructions above the experiment. Progress belongs exclusively to this rail.
Stack five fixed regions with labeled residual bypasses. Highlight only the active region. Wrap labels and phase descriptions without reducing readability.
Anchor beside the active region without covering links. Identify the operation and explain its mechanism; reserve numerical values for readouts.
Show the bound status and residual-addition counter below the picture. Counts equal completed residual additions in the selected state, not elapsed time.

states.label: Input
states.sentence: At the input stream, track B’s vector through the block.
states.why: Positions A, B, and C are illustrative; B is fixed as the focus, with inference mode and no output head.

states.label: Attention
states.sentence: The attention branch normalizes x, projects queries, keys, and values, applies RoPE to queries and keys, then computes a projected attention update.
states.why: For B, causal masking permits A and B but excludes C; attention weights combine their value vectors.

readouts.label: Status
readouts.value: B attends to A and B; C is masked

states.label: Add attention
states.sentence: At the attention residual sum, add the attention update to the original stream x, producing u.
states.why: The bypass carries x around normalization and attention, so the branch updates the stream rather than replacing it.

readouts.label: Status
readouts.value: Running stream u contains x plus the attention update

states.label: MLP
states.sentence: The MLP branch normalizes u, applies the SwiGLU gated transformation, and projects the result back to the stream width.
states.why: The same MLP acts independently at every position; B’s input already carries context gathered by attention.

readouts.label: Status
readouts.value: MLP transforms B’s contextual vector without reading other positions

states.label: Add MLP
states.sentence: At the MLP residual sum, add the MLP update to u, producing output y.
states.why: Both branches preserve the running stream through addition; only attention mixes information across positions.

readouts.label: Status
readouts.value: Attention mixes positions; MLP acts separately per position
